_comment: VS Code images scripts/build/shots.mjs cannot find in vscode/.shot-gates.json: the ones taken by hand, and the ones taken under another pipeline state (SF_MOCK_PIPELINE_STATE) then copied in under another name. 'file' is the name the harness writes, the key the name the labs use.

pipeline-branch-modal-uat._env_comment: The window of uat, which has no merge target before Level 3, so it shows its go-lives: the point is the uat box in devops-pipeline.png.

pipeline-branch-modal-level3._env_comment: The level3 diagram is laid out differently: the point is the integration box in devops-pipeline-level3.png, in window pixels.

devops-pipeline-promotion._env_comment: Lab 3.10: the level3 pipeline with enablePromotionBranches on and the promotion of US-057 open on the uat to preprod arrow. The promotion variant is a separate fixture overlay, so every other capture keeps a project with no promotion in flight.

pipeline-branch-modal-promotion._env_comment: Lab 3.10 step 4: the uat window with its checkbox column, five stories waiting, US-061, US-059 and US-057 ticked and the two others left alone. The uat node of the level3 diagram and the rows to tick come from promotionNode and promotionRows of the helios universe fixture.

promotion-create-select._env_comment: Lab 3.10 step 4: the command the Create promotion button ran, stopped on the selection to confirm, with the three ticked stories pre-filled.

promotion-create-conflict._env_comment: Lab 3.10 step 4: the same run stopped on the conflict question of the US-059 cherry-pick, the recommended answer first.

promotion-create-completed._env_comment: Lab 3.10 step 5: the end of the run, with the warning about the markers and the prompt report file next to the Pull Request button.

promotion-conflict-editor._env_comment: Lab 3.10 step 6: the Panel Batch layout as the promotion committed it, open in the editor with the Accept Current / Accept Incoming / Accept Both code lenses of VS Code over the conflict block.

pipeline-config-danger._env_comment: Lab 3.1 step 10 and Lab 3.10 step 1: the Danger Zone of the Global Pipeline Settings, where enablePromotionBranches and allowedPromotionSteps are set.

pipeline-cards-level1._comment: The cards as Level 1 sees them: no feature branch and no open Pull Request yet. The default state is the Level 2 world.

pipeline-cards-first-pr._comment: Lab 1.6: the cards once the Pull Request of US-014 is open, for the My Pull Request card.

pipeline-pr-window-validation._comment: Lab 1.6: the window of the Pull Request of US-014 on its Validation tab, with the comment of a real run of the lab.

pipeline-pr-window-files._comment: Lab 1.6: the same window with the Files button opened, listing the reports of the validation job.

pipeline-pr-window-running._comment: Lab 1.6: the same window while the deployment check is still running.

pipeline-review-pr._comment: Lab 3.2: the Level 3 pipeline with Mariia's Pull Request for US-052 next to its branch.

pipeline-pr-window-review-files._comment: Lab 3.2: the window of that Pull Request with the Files button opened, on the reports of a real run of the lab.

pipeline-packages-menu._comment: Only Lab 1.5 shows it, so it is taken in the Level 1 state.

pipeline-pr-actions-list._comment: Lab 2.3 shows the one action its Pull Request carries: the fixture holds one of each type for the editor captures, so this keeps only the backfill.

package-xml-filtered._comment: Labs 2.2 and 2.4. Listed here until the first capture writes its gate into .shot-gates.json.

editor-field-file._comment: Labs 2.2 and 2.4. Listed here until the first capture writes its gate into .shot-gates.json.

editor-crew-capacity-csv._comment: Labs 2.2 and 2.4. Listed here until the first capture writes its gate into .shot-gates.json.

pipeline-settings-menu-level3._comment: Lab 3.6: the gear menu on the finished four stage pipeline, open on DORA metrics.

scratch-org-pool._comment: Lab 3.1: the Scratch Org Pool panel Helios would have, from the scratchOrgPool key mocks.mjs writes. Listed here until the first capture writes its gate into .shot-gates.json.

org-initialization._comment: Lab 3.1: the Org Initialization panel with the steps a new Helios scratch org would get (orgInit key of mocks.mjs).

replacement-rules._comment: Lab 3.1: the Replacement Rules panel with the warehouse URL of each Helios org (replacementRules key of mocks.mjs).

dora-metrics._comment: Lab 3.6: the DORA metrics panel on its Overview tab. The report is the Helios one mocks.mjs generates, the evening of the first release.

dora-metrics-production._comment: Lab 3.6: the tab of main, named by doraBranchTab in the universe.

dora-metrics-export-menu._comment: Lab 3.6: the Export menu open. The harness takes it only when the universe names the point of the button (doraExportMenu).

pipeline-config-branch-merge-target._env_comment: Lab 3.1 step 8: the Deployment tab of the uat branch, unlocked, with preprod as its merge target. The level3 state is the one where uat merges into preprod.
